overview_description.description: Slauth.io is an IAM Policy Copilot that suggests secure IAM policies based on the observed activity of a newly developed service identity i.e. micro-service. As opposed to a DevOps engineer having to manually write a policy and hope it is secure, Slauth suggests the most secure policy through a PR within seconds. We save DevOps engineers countless of hours and reduce technical debt which results in security vulnerabilities. Integrations with Terraform are also available.
